scope: Synthetic local ACP subprocesses and actual source exports; no native agent or provider

tests.diagnostic: The deliberately duplicated success response after an RPC error produced an SDK unknown-request diagnostic; the turn remained failed.

limits: This is a historical upstream characterization, not qualification of a fixed fork.
The observation probe used only fixed synthetic sentinels. No raw payload, prompt, thought, stderr, credential, private path or configuration is retained in this report.
The bounded 512-event queue probe demonstrates retention at that size; absence of an application-level bound is established by source inspection, not a stress or exhaustion claim.
Full inherited checks, socket checks, independent review, installed-Pi interoperability and fork publication have not been qualified by this audit.
